comparison.objective: Insert and seat a swivelling tie-rod ball stud in a tapered knuckle hole; candidate transfers a bearing block onto a service jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests controlling an articulated swinging linkage while aligning and pressing a taper. Candidate tests holding two linear supports flush and parallel while sliding an uncaged recirculating block across their seam.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires taper depth, coaxiality, stillness, release, and clear hands. Candidate additionally depends on uninterrupted support and retention of every freely moving ball.
comparison.reason: The record is articulated peg seating into a terminal socket; it does not test transfer across a mated support interface or rolling-element preservation.
